privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.controller.body: Sentinel is operated by your organization. The data controller is your organization's administrator.
privacy.data.body: We collect the following data as part of using the service: profile information (name, email address, language, theme), time tracking data, ticket activity (comments, changes, attachments, assignments), audit logs related to your activity.
privacy.purpose.body: Your data is processed exclusively for: providing the Sentinel service, managing your account, security and access auditing.
privacy.retention.body: Your data is retained for the duration of your active account. Upon account deletion, your personally identifiable information (name, email) is immediately pseudonymized. References to your activity (comments, ticket history, attachments) are retained anonymously to preserve your organization's data integrity. Audit logs are retained without a defined time limit.
privacy.rights.body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your data. These rights can be exercised directly from your profile.
privacy.rights.profile_link: Manage my data from my profile
privacy.security.body: Data is protected by encryption (HTTPS), secure authentication (JWT + BCrypt), multi-tenant isolation, and access logging.
privacy.contact.body: For any questions regarding the protection of your data, contact your organization's administrator or our support.
